checks.finding: Manuscript states 8 resistant / 3 sensitive (EOC227=Resistant). Repo's corrected resistance_labels.json (2026-05-09, from Zhang Table 1) says 7R/4S with EOC227=Sensitive (PFI 230d>=180d). Package is internally inconsistent with its own corrected source-of-truth.

BriTROC described as n=47 paired, n=40 with labels, and 3 resistant across files. These are reconcilable (47 paired CN -> 40 with first-line labels -> 3 resistant) but must be stated consistently. W2 confirmed: 47 paired CN, 40 labeled, 3 resistant.

checks.topic: prognostic vs predictive vs temporal monitoring
checks.finding: AUDIT_REPORT_JAN29 (repo's own audit) flags that the package proves PROGNOSTIC value (high post-treatment score -> shorter PFI) but NOT temporal prediction (alerting X months before an event). The OV-045 red-team showed the resistance signal was present continuously (TF 1.0% at day56, 0.8% at day362), so 'detect 3-6 months before progression' is unsupported and likely a chronic-risk flag, not a temporal alarm. Report must use prognostic language and downgrade the 'serial monitoring / early detection' claim to dynamic risk-stratification.

Manuscript Future Directions calls MSK-Spectrum 'dbGaP access pending' while AUDIT_REPORT_JAN29 states the data is possessed locally and already benchmarked (OV-045). Status text is outdated. (Note: MSK-Spectrum is controlled-access and NOT used in this validation; open supp only.)
checks.verdict: DISCREPANT (data-status text stale) - low impact on published results

checks.finding: Introduction states 'Pathway changes during treatment (not baseline state) predict resistance,' but Results show pathway DELTAS are NOT predictive - the opposite. The core thesis is that ABSOLUTE post-treatment state (not change) predicts. Introduction wording contradicts the finding.
Directions of effect (post-DDR high, CN-sig-7/CCNE1, PI3K) are biologically coherent with known HGSOC platinum-resistance mechanisms.
checks.verdict: SUPPORTED (direction plausible; not a substitute for power/validation)

biology.post_ddr_high->resistant: Coherent. Platinum kills via DNA crosslinks; tumor cells retaining intact/high DNA-damage-repair capacity after chemo are selected and drive platinum resistance (enhanced repair, HR restoration). Directionally consistent with literature.
biology.CN_signature_7->CCNE1: Signature 7 in the BriTROC CN-signature framework is associated with CCNE1 amplification. CCNE1 amplification is a recognized platinum-resistance / HR-proficiency mechanism in HGSOC, mutually exclusive with BRCA loss. Higher s7 at relapse -> resistant is biologically plausible.
biology.PI3K_high->resistant: Plausible: PI3K/AKT/mTOR activation supports survival/proliferation of resistant clones, but PI3K signal here is weaker and gene-set-sensitive.
biology.caveat: Biological plausibility supports the DIRECTION of effect but does not substitute for adequately powered, externally validated, calibrated evidence.

clinical_utility_framing.intended_use_RUO: Exploratory, research-use-only prognostic biomarker concept: post-treatment (residual) molecular state (pathway expression or CN signatures) associated with platinum resistance in HGSOC. NOT for clinical decision-making.
clinical_utility_framing.what_is_shown: (1) Discovery association of post-NACT DDR/PI3K pathway scores with PFI (n=11, apparent, uncorrected); (2) Independent external reproduction that CN signature 7 at relapse discriminates platinum resistance (n=40, 3 resistant) better than at diagnosis (+0.18 AUROC). Consistent DIRECTION across two modalities and cohorts.
clinical_utility_framing.what_is_NOT_shown: Clinical utility, calibration, prespecified thresholds, net benefit, temporal early-warning capability, generalizability, or adequate statistical power. No cross-validation on discovery; extreme class imbalance in external cohort.
clinical_utility_framing.comparator: CA-125 kinetics (KELIM), BRCA/HRD status, baseline genomic profiling.
roadmap_to_true_validation: Prespecify a single locked score + threshold before any validation.
External cohort with balanced classes and adequate events (EPV>=10; target >=30-50 resistant events).
Nested cross-validation / independent test set; report outer-fold metrics, not apparent.
Calibration (calibration curve, Brier) and decision-curve / net-benefit analysis.
Head-to-head vs KELIM and BRCA/HRD; test incremental value (KELIM+SAE > KELIM).
Distinguish prognostic (risk state) from predictive (event timing); if monitoring claimed, prospective serial-sampling study with prespecified lead-time endpoint.
Prospective/interventional confirmation before any clinical-utility claim.
